children: NewAmsterdam Pharma announced European Commission marketing authorizations for Ubeslo (obicetrapib 10 mg) and Evlarco (obicetrapib 10 mg + ezetimibe 10 mg) — the first global approvals for obicetrapib.
EC authorized Ubeslo and Evlarco for primary hypercholesterolaemia (HeFH and non-familial) and mixed dyslipidaemia across EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.
Authorizations include standard post-approval safety monitoring and a required post-authorization efficacy study: final PREVAIL cardiovascular outcomes trial results must be submitted.
Menarini holds exclusive commercialization rights in Europe; NewAmsterdam Pharma receives tiered double-digit royalties on net sales in the territory.
Up to €833 million in milestone payments possible; mid-teens of millions triggered by the EC marketing authorizations for obicetrapib and the FDC.
